result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may assign without consent to affiliates and qualifying transaction successors; Contractor remains subject to Company's consent under the existing not-unreasonably-withheld standard and is absolutely prohibited from assigning to a Company competitor; and Company change of control creates no Contractor termination right. The notice requirement and related no-suspension/no-repricing protections are narrowly connected to the assignment and change-of-control issue. Unrelated commercial terms are unchanged, and the drafting is clear and professional.
